name: IndustryLuma
tagline: Factory performance, resource efficiency and practical industry calculations.

tool.title: Overall Equipment Effectiveness Calculator
tool.intro: Calculate OEE using availability, performance and quality percentages.
tool.formula: OEE = Availability × Performance × Quality, expressed as proportions. It helps compare operational effectiveness.
tool.caution: The result is a diagnostic KPI, not a financial or regulatory certification. Enter comparable periods.

design.heroNote: Practical calculations for factories, agriculture, resource efficiency and responsible operations.
design.audience: Production managers, engineers and operations teams.
